nextStoryContext: US-002 was a comment-only sweep: reworded the identity-panel header comment in src/ui/Splash.tsx (lines 3, 5, 11: 'CAM Runtime' -> 'Gateship' in the module banner, twice in the wordmark/Runtime-line description) and the two brand-token JSDoc comments in src/design/tokens.ts (line 74's brandGreens header, line 96's brandNeutrals header). No token values, no Fir Green hex (#10C66F), no wordmark glyph art, and no rendered frame changed -- verified via test/ui/splash.test.tsx staying green (2 pass, unchanged assertions). Tree-wide sweep confirmed zero 'CAM Runtime' occurrences anywhere under src/ (excluding src/vendor/_generated.ts, which is generated and untouched). ADR-0050's pin of invariance re-verified live against origin main: the CAM_VERSION/CAM_SESSION env-var file-set and the 'tmux -L cam' socket-literal file-set are both byte-identical between local main and this branch's src/ -- no internal contract was touched, this story was strictly comment prose. Both budgeted files stayed within their existing file-size ceilings (tokens.ts 108/109, Splash.tsx 132/134) so no budget raise was needed. Remaining dead-name occurrences (if any) outside src/ -- docs, README, CHANGELOG, package.json, scripts/, templates/ -- are out of this story's scope (AC3's oracle is scoped to `src/` only) and should be independently swept by whichever later story in this PRD owns that surface, re-verifying ADR-0050's invariance pin before touching any CAM_*/tmux-socket/slash-command literal.
